ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

3. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

4. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 15
   D. 56

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

6. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 6
   C. 6
   D. 5

7. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 72
   C. 1
   D. 17

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

9. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 10

10. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 18
   C. 77
   D. 36

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

14. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 6
   C. 12.5
   D. 5

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 31
   C. 17
   D. 25

16. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

17. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

18. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 36

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 105
   C. 22
   D. 30

21. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

22. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

23. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

24. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 32

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
